6. Mr. Chowdhury further submits that the occurrence allegedly was committed during 2003-2006 i.e. before enactment of the Money Laundering Prevention Act, 2009 and that of 2012, but charge has been framed against the petitioner under the provisions of the said Acts and also under the Act of 2002, which causes prejudice to him in taking defence. It also vitiates the proceedings for misjoinder of charges. 

 12. We have considered the submissions of the learned Advocates as well as the Attorney- General and gone through the record carefully. The point of misjoinder of charges was also argued in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No.51668 of 2014 in a different language, and the High Court Division disposed of the said miscellaneous case with necessary observations in respect of that point by order dated 13-11-2014, wherein one of us was a party. So, we need not to reply the same point again.
